activation: Only independent preparation. No accepted build_batches input, bank registration, successor, catalog/crosswalk/count/history activation, receipt, merge or issue closure before the coordinator grants the slot after actual cohort30 and cohort20 delivery.

evidence_requirements: Preparation: reviewed current Entra-role guidance and precise directory questions only; Azure role assignments, role definitions, policy/query associations and managed identities cannot establish Entra directory authority or least privilege.

Reviewer decision: cite separately authorized redacted directory-role scope, active/eligible assignment and privilege review evidence against actual responsibilities and least-privileged built-in alternatives; no principal names or directory records.

Reviewer decision: justify every Global Administrator use that cannot be handled by another existing role, distinguishing normal administration from the separately governed permanent-active emergency access exception. No invented blanket custom-role policy.
recommendations.limitations: Directory configuration, effective authority, privilege need and actual emergency-only use remain human-evidenced. No Graph resource, directory read, role/group/PIM operation or inferred Entra privilege from Azure RBAC.

evidence_requirements: Preparation: explicit scoped VM zone/location and typed availability-set reference with known unique scoped set fault/update-domain counts. No inferred placement defaults or current regional availability.

Reviewer decision: independently identify the complete applicable AD DS controller population with redacted authorized evidence; VM names, tags, resource type, OS, extensions and location do not identify domain controllers.

Reviewer decision: demonstrate at least two actual controllers across different available zones, or a suitable availability set where zones are unavailable in that specific region, and substantiate operating health/replication independently. Supplied VM/set configuration is not complete inventory or resilience proof.
recommendations.limitations: No DC discovery, guest inspection, SKU/zone availability read, health/failover probe or automatic applicability. Missing/null/duplicate/wrong-type/foreign/denied/partial/stale evidence is not a pass. An empty explicit zone list means only nonzonal supplied configuration.

evidence_requirements: Preparation: supplied scoped VM locations and bounded explicit managed-domain replica subnet/location configurations. Resource metadata locations are not region availability or identity-resource designation; Terraform supplies only its initial replica subset.

Reviewer decision: identify applicable identity services, required workload/recovery regions and complete authorized service population, then reconcile actual multi-region service and workload placement with approved recovery requirements.

Reviewer decision: for self-managed AD DS, substantiate regional sites/subnets, replication and actual local DC locator/resolution/use with redacted dated references. Managed Domain Services replicas all share one AD site and do not support separate AD sites or replication settings; review its full-mesh connectivity and workload design separately.
recommendations.limitations: Entra ID global services, regional AD DS, and managed Domain Services are different. VM/region/subnet labels and configured replicas prove neither DC roles nor site association, local resolution, replication health or regional recovery. No AD/guest/network probe or directory payload.

evidence_requirements: Preparation: existing minimized assignment principal type/typed role definition plus explicit Azure role type and validated supported assignable-scope count, with unique known scoped joins only. No action content, principal IDs, role display names or descriptions.

Reviewer decision: reconcile approved platform/network/security/subscription/application responsibilities and separation of duties with actual effective Azure permissions, inheritance, conditions, eligibility, exclusions and independently attributable team ownership.

Reviewer decision: prefer adequate built-in roles and justify custom roles only where required by actual needs under current guidance, explicitly resolving the frozen checklist's blanket custom-role wording. An Azure role grants no Entra directory authority.
recommendations.limitations: Role type/scope count or joined definition existence proves neither least privilege, correct team alignment, effective access nor complete assignment population. Unsupported assignable scopes and generated/unbound Terraform role IDs remain explicit. No permissions changes or raw role actions.

evidence_requirements: Preparation: reviewed capability and migration questions only; no runtime compatibility inference from domain resource, SKU, role, subnet or replica configuration.

Reviewer decision: independently inventory every applicable workload and its domain-join, LDAP bind/read/write, Kerberos/NTLM, Group Policy, schema/privilege and trust dependencies; cite redacted compatibility assessments and attributable actual test references.

Reviewer decision: reconcile the stand-alone managed-domain model, one-way identity synchronization, writes restricted for synchronized objects, external identities, trust/forest limitations and migration/rollback acceptance for all applicable workloads. Modern Entra-native applications and legacy domain dependencies differ.
recommendations.limitations: Inherently manual workload compatibility and migration judgment remains manual. Neither service existence nor provider support is a tested compatibility outcome; no domain join, account, credential, trust, deployment or workload test is executed.

evidence_requirements: Preparation: RG-scoped Microsoft.AAD/domainServices explicit SKU and at most five embedded replicas, each with normalized configured location and typed unique subnet. Known scoped subnet/VNet joins are partial configuration context only.

Reviewer decision: reconcile the full replica population and actual supported regions/subscriptions, Enterprise/Premium requirement for multiple replicas, full-mesh VNet connectivity and required redundant regional workload placement.

Reviewer decision: substantiate actual replication/service health and geographical recovery separately. All managed replicas share one AD site. Terraform's initial_replica_set is explicitly a supplied subset; separately managed provider replicas are not invented ARM child resources or absence evidence.
recommendations.limitations: No configured count, SKU, region label or subnet binding proves healthy replicas, supported current capacity, complete population or application recovery. Raw domain names, IPs, diagnostics, notifications, certificates and trust/password material are withheld. No new live route.

evidence_requirements: Preparation: current Entra integration/prerequisite questions and explicit tenant-plane limitation. Actual microsoft.aadiam/diagnosticSettings is tenant-only, unlike Microsoft.Insights/diagnosticSettings; no subscription-scope synthetic directory diagnostic record or new tenant scope.

Reviewer decision: cite independently authorized, redacted directory AuditLogs/SignInLogs category routing and actual platform-central workspace ownership/destination configuration, with separate directory Security Administrator and workspace/data-access authorization.

Reviewer decision: demonstrate successful arriving tenant log coverage, time window, agreed retention, query/alert suitability and operating responsibilities with attributable references. Azure activity/resource diagnostics, a workspace or configured route alone cannot establish Entra ingestion or central integration.
recommendations.limitations: Tenant diagnostics are unsupported within the existing assessment/collection boundary and remain an explicit human-evidence gap. No Graph/Entra/log read, query execution, raw sign-in/audit record, fabricated category or data-plane payload.

evidence_requirements: Preparation: current source-backed emergency operating and authentication questions only; the frozen October 2024 statement is historical, not universal current tenant enforcement.

Reviewer decision: separately substantiate the scoped emergency account operating model, at least two cloud-only accounts, permanent-active emergency GA exception, no federation dependency, authorized shared-versus-individual model, safe separate custody, secure workstations, use alerts, post-use review and at-least-90-day validation using redacted dated references.

Reviewer decision: separately substantiate phishing-resistant passkey/FIDO2 or appropriate certificate-based MFA, independent dependencies from normal admin methods and non-expiring/non-cleaned credentials/devices. Reconcile blocking/restricting Conditional Access exclusions separately from report-only policies and mandatory MFA; neither configuration nor an exception invents authentication success.

Reviewer decision: reconcile applicable enforcement phase and tenant rollout: phase 1 portals CRUD from October 2024, phase 2 gradually from October 1 2025 CLI/PowerShell/IaC/control-plane create/update/delete with read operations excluded; workload identities are unaffected. No account identifiers, method registrations, credential/passkey/certificate data or test sign-ins.
recommendations.limitations: Emergency account operations and strong-authentication suitability remain separate blank decisions, never Azure RBAC or configured-flag outcomes. No account creation, permission/PIM/MFA/CA/credential operation, login, validation drill or claim of current tenant rollout.
